system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Insight and Society, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Legal Lore, Criminal Networks Lore, Forensics Lore.
system.description: You made a living finding what people had concealed, from missing property to the explanation for a death. You learned to test a convincing account against what a place and its people actually revealed.
